caption: The Shopify screen Select a plan for the app AgentNest: the section Free to test (These plans are free to test on this store. Regular pricing applies when the store goes live.) with the Free card (Unlimited catalog scans, Catalog readiness score, Product-level issue reports, View catalog findings) and a button Select, and the section Unavailable on dev stores (These plans can't be selected while the store is in development) with Starter $19 / 30 days, Growth $49 / 30 days and Scale $99 / 30 days, each with a greyed out button Not available and the start of a line about successful automated fixes; the store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The Shopify screen Approve charge for AgentNest by Ecommerce Storez, Plan Free, Subscription details Free, and on the right Your next bill with the sentence This plan is free. You will not be billed. and a button Approve; there is no payment method row; the store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The page Usage & Billing of the app: Current plan Free (Unlimited scans and reports with no AgentNest-applied fixes), a dark card Successful fixes 0 with Upgrade to apply fixes and a reset date of 17 Dec 2026, the cards Scanning Unlimited and Completed changes Remain in Shopify, and the block Upgrade when you are ready to apply fixes with the sentence that Shopify manages plan selection and that AgentNest does not collect payment details; the store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.

The dashboard of the app after the button Run first catalog scan was used: the heading Welcome to AgentNest followed by the store name (hidden), a ring Overall readiness that still shows -- out of 100, and three cards Critical, Automatic and Input needed with -- and of 0 products have critical issues, 1-click fixes and require your input; no error message and no scan result; the store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden.
